segments.speaker: rep
segments.text: Good morning Tom, can you hear me clearly?

segments.speaker: prospect
segments.text: Loud and clear. I have about twenty minutes.

segments.speaker: rep
segments.text: Perfect. What made you take this meeting?

segments.speaker: prospect
segments.text: We hired eight new reps and ramping them is taking forever.

segments.speaker: prospect
segments.text: Right now everything lives in HubSpot and our sequences run through Outreach.

segments.speaker: rep
segments.text: How do you coach the new hires on live calls?

segments.speaker: prospect
segments.text: We built a little internal tool that flags keywords, so I am not sure we need another system.

segments.speaker: rep
segments.text: Fair enough. What does that tool miss?

segments.speaker: prospect
segments.text: It only works after the call, so it never helps in the moment.

segments.speaker: prospect
segments.text: Is the pricing per seat, and is there a free trial?

segments.speaker: rep
segments.text: Per seat, and we can do a two week trial.

segments.speaker: prospect
segments.text: The last quote we got for something like this was way too expensive.

segments.speaker: prospect
segments.text: Also procurement has to review every new vendor, which takes a while.

segments.speaker: rep
segments.text: I can send our security documents now so procurement can get started.

segments.speaker: prospect
segments.text: That works. Let's set up the trial for three reps on Monday.
